briefdescription.para: Write a buffer of bytes to the UART (blocking).
Read bytes from the UART RX ring buffer.

detaileddescription.para: Reads up to max_len bytes that have been received. Non-blocking: returns immediately with however many bytes are available.

parameterdescription.para: Maximum number of bytes to read.

briefdescription.para: Feed a received byte into the UART RX ring buffer.

detaileddescription.para: Call this from your UART RX ISR to push incoming data into the driver's buffer.

simplesect.para: true if the byte was stored, false if the RX buffer is full.

briefdescription.para: Non-blocking write to UART TX ring buffer (all-or-nothing atomic).

detaileddescription.para: Pushes data into the internal TX ring buffer if space is available for all len bytes, and enables the TX interrupt to drain asynchronously. Returns SYN_BUSY without modifying the buffer if space is insufficient.

simplesect.para: SYN_OK on success, SYN_BUSY if ring buffer free space < len.

briefdescription.para: TX ISR drain callback — call from UART TXE interrupt.

detaileddescription.para: Pops the next byte from tx_rb into the hardware data register. When the ring buffer empties, disables the TXE interrupt.

simplesect.para: true if a byte was transmitted, false if tx_rb is empty.

briefdescription.para: Check if asynchronous TX is complete (tx_rb drained AND hardware shift register clear).

simplesect.para: true if no bytes remain in software tx_rb AND hardware TC flag is set.
